description: Lists and loads skills: Replo's written guides to which Replo tool does what, building and publishing sites and pages, brand kits, analytics, and each integration, plus the user's own skills (me:<name>) and the team skills of every project they can open (project:<name>). Without names, returns every skill's name and one-line description. With names, returns each skill's full SKILL.md and the paths of the files it bundles; load one of those files by its skill directory and path, such as building-replo-pages/references/fonts.md. An unknown name returns the closest matches. Call it first when Replo work takes several steps or creates or edits a site or page, and when a Replo tool's description names a skill. Pick skills by their descriptions: replo explains which tool does what, building-replo-pages covers site and page work, and each integration's skill is named by its key, such as shopify. Personal and project copies are listed separately, even with the same short name; when several projects have a skill by the same name, each copy is listed as project:<name>@<projectId>. The list shows 100 of the user's skills at a time: when it returns nextCursor, call skills with that cursor for more; any skill loads by name without listing it. Works without a Replo account (Replo's skills only): call it before asking the user to sign in.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous list, for the next page of your skills. Any skill loads by name without it.

name.description: One skill or bundled file to load; prefer names.

names.description: Skills or bundled files to load by the names the list gives (klaviyo, me:brand-voice, project:brand-voice, building-replo-pages/references/fonts.md). Leave it out to list skills: Replo's, your own and your projects' team skills.

name: skills
title: Read skills
